name: oh-my-opus
description: Model-aware prompting rules for Claude Code. A SessionStart hook detects the active model and injects the matching ruleset from Anthropic's per-model prompting guides (Opus 5, Fable 5.1), and a PostModelSwitch hook re-injects when you switch models mid-session. /opus-prompt rewrites a rough request; /opus-setup audits your CLAUDE.md for rules that fight the active model.
